title: Falling rigid bodies (Blender)
description: Blender simulates 12 colliding blocks over 90 frames. Compare saved renders at frames 1, 18 and 90. The .blend contains the simulation setup; play from frame 1 to recalculate it.
description_ko: Blender로 블록 12개의 충돌을 90프레임 동안 계산했어요. 1·18·90프레임의 저장된 렌더를 비교하세요. .blend에는 시뮬레이션 설정이 있으며 1프레임부터 재생하면 다시 계산해요.
made_with: blender through a bundled, executed recipe
summary: Compare 12 rigid bodies before, during and after their fall and collisions.
summary_ko: 강체 블록 12개의 낙하 전·중간·충돌 후 렌더를 비교해요.
try: Edit build.py and rerun the recipe to change the scene
try_ko: build.py를 수정하고 레시피를 다시 실행해 장면을 바꾸세요
tool_about: Blender simulates 12 colliding blocks over 90 frames. Compare saved renders at frames 1, 18 and 90. The .blend contains the simulation setup; play from frame 1 to recalculate it.
